patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...). Inside that directory, there will be a folder named 'game'. Download the patch file from the link below Move the downloaded patch file into the 'game' folder mentioned above It's working if: There will be a + symbol on the bottom right of the 'First Snow' logo when the game starts.
